evidence_policy.A: Root- or stem-oriented source evidence; may nominate a provisional root for review.
evidence_policy.B: Kapampangan lexical attestation; corroborates a form but does not by itself prove productive-root status.
evidence_policy.C: Community or collaboratively edited lexical attestation; discovery/corroboration only.

sources.title: Kapampangan Dictionary
sources.author: Michael L. Forman
sources.use: Root-oriented full-word headword evidence; cross-reference entries and explicitly unaffixable particles/substitutes are retained only as lexical evidence.

sources.title: Vocabulary of the Kapampangan Language in Spanish and Dictionary of the Spanish Language in Kapampangan
sources.author: Diego Bergaño; English translation by Venancio Q. Samson
sources.license: Local supplied translation; extracted text is not redistributed. University of Michigan access is for educational and research use.
sources.use: Historical headword evidence. Only entries explicitly labelled root are treated as root evidence.

sources.author: Robert Blust, Stephen Trussel, Alexander D. Smith, and Robert Forkel
sources.use: Kapampangan lexical and explicitly notated derived-form corroboration; some records ultimately cite Forman and are not independent.

sources.title: UCLA Phonetics Lab Archive Kapampangan Word Lists
